decisions.reason: As a 2023 product line built directly on the firm's established geospatial software components and already given its own page, it is a low-cost option to keep open while demand and model mix become clearer.

The building data digital twin service fits the firm's strategic direction and customer base but is somewhat more market- and implementation-intensive, so it is more uncertain yet still worth retaining for another year.

This authentication and identity delegation service is close to the existing offer and likely inexpensive to maintain as an option, so the firm would usually wait for more evidence before abandoning it.

An open GIS application development framework is closely aligned with the firm's technical capabilities and ecosystem strategy, and as a product line it offers flexibility that favors continued experimentation rather than exit.

The new identity and access service for GIS applications was explicitly launched in 2023 and supports broader enterprise integration, so despite some overlap risk it is still early and cheap enough to keep on the market.
